newsitem.title: USA: Beacon Properties to close $50 mln in deals.
newsitem.headline: Beacon Properties to close $50 mln in deals.

text.p: Beacon Properties Corp will close one or two more acquisitions of commercial office properties worth more than $50 million in all by the end of the year, the company's chief executive told Reuters.
Chief Executive Alan Leventhal did not identify the properties or say where they were located.

Boston-based Beacon Properties has acquired $950 million worth of properties so far in 1996 -- meaning another $50 million would put the company over $1 billion worth of acquisitions for the year, he added.

The company, which in 1996 added Chicago, Atlanta and Los Angeles as sites of its commercial office properties, will buy properties in California's Bay-area in 1997 as well as expand in its core markets, he said.

The company will make more than $1 billion in acquisitions in 1997, he added, with about 95 percent of them being existing commercial office properties and the remainder being properties the company will develop itself.

To pay for its 1997 acquisitions, the company will issue shares of its stock to owners of the acquired properties and also take on more debt, Leventhal said. He did not say how much additional debt the company would take on. It now has about $550 million of debt, he said.
The company has no plans to acquire or develop any properties other than commercial office peoperties -- its present focus, he added.
